name: find_contact
summary: Search Contacts.app by name; returns matching people with their phone numbers (and labels like mobile/home/work). Use to discover the exact number to dial or to disambiguate an ambiguous name.

params.name: name
params.description: Name (or part of a name) to search Contacts for.

name: call
summary: Place a phone or FaceTime call. STAGED; irreversible (no undo). Provide EITHER number OR contact_name (resolved via Contacts at confirmation). Method: default 'cellular' (via a paired iPhone); 'facetime_audio' when no iPhone is available or the person is better reached on FaceTime; 'facetime_video' only when the user explicitly asks for video / 'a FaceTime call'.

params.name: method
params.description: 'cellular' = phone call via a paired iPhone (default). 'facetime_audio' = FaceTime audio (when cellular isn't available or the contact is reached on FaceTime). 'facetime_video' = FaceTime video (only when the user explicitly asks for video).

params.name: number
params.description: Explicit number to call. Provide this OR contact_name, not both. Digits with an optional leading '+' and spaces/dashes/parentheses; no letters.

params.name: contact_name
params.description: Name to look up in Contacts and call. Provide this OR number, not both. If it matches multiple people (or one person with multiple numbers), the call is refused and candidates are listed — retry with an explicit number.
